answer: Require every agent to lock a 50 POA stake for 30 days before earning, so an atlas of fake identities costs real capital instead of free creation. Flag agents whose task patterns match above a 90% similarity threshold as one farm: the shared pigment of identical timing, wallet funding, and task overlap gives the cluster away. A caught farm loses 100% of its stake and rewards - no hollow identity survives the audit. Example: 200 bots copying trade calls were clustered and slashed in one sweep, costing the attacker 10,000 POA for zero payout.
